{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = (data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
refunded_mask = (data['status'] == 'refunded')
completed_mask = (data['status'] == 'completed')

filtered_data = data[completed_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Extract values
email_avg = avg_revenue_by_channel['email']
paid_search_avg = avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']
difference = email_avg - paid_search_avg

# Compute within-segment averages
stratified_avg = filtered_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Extract segment-specific values
email_loyal = stratified_avg.loc['email', 'loyal']
paid_search_loyal = stratified_avg.loc['paid_search', 'loyal']
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal

email_returning = stratified_avg.loc['email', 'returning']
paid_search_returning = stratified_avg.loc['paid_search', 'returning']
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

email_new = stratified_avg.loc['email', 'new']
paid_search_new = stratified_avg.loc['paid_search', 'new']
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new

# Now print only the exact values needed, with two decimal places
print(f"{email_avg:.2f}")
print(f"{paid_search_avg:.2f}")
print(f"{difference:.2f}")
print(f"{email_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"{paid_search_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"{diff_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"{email_returning:.2f}")
print(f"{paid_search_returning:.2f}")
print(f"{diff_returning:.2f}")
print(f"{email_new:.2f}")
print(f"{paid_search_new:.2f}")
print(f"{diff_new:.2f}")"}
